exercises.title: Add and MayContain
exercises.task: The positions are computed for you by slots. Fill Add (set every slot) and MayContain (one clear slot is proof that the value was never added). Run measures, for k from 1 to 12, how often the filter wrongly says yes: you will see a best k, and why more hashing is not always better.
hints: MayContain returns false at the first slot that is not set, and true after the loop.
